name: Tidehopper
method: Direct visual review of front, back and both generated profiles. File validation is separate from design approval.
confirmed: Blue-grey frog with cream underside, large folded hind limbs and small forelimbs preserved.
Pearly overlapping shell dome and barnacles present in all views.
Profiles face opposite directions with one eye visible; no added tail or fins.
limitations: Rear webbed toes spread toward viewer; verify rear foot orientation against side stance.
Shell tile arrangement and barnacle placement vary across views; establish fixed landmark map.
Side eyes and chest retain some oblique volume; strict orthographic alignment not proven.
Hidden far hind limb attachments require anatomical construction before animation.
Image scale differs between front/rear and side references.
next: Resolve landmarks, foot direction and hidden joints, normalize framing, then separate articulated parts and author animation. Not an animation-ready approval.
